content:
**Design doc**: .design/llm-moderation-assist.md
**Implements**: REQ-C1..C4; AC-7

**Files to add**:
- polaris-backend/src/llm/recommend_dispatcher.rs

**Triggers**: pull (POST /api/cases/:id/llm-recommendation), push (new report on covered subject), manual replay (calibration).

**Per-case flow**:
1. Hydrate via case_context::hydrate (#234)
2. Call ClassifierClient::recommend (#232)
3. Persist LlmRecommendation observation (#233)
4. Per RecommendedAction: resolve effective mode via safety_floors (#235) → manual / assisted (#236) / autonomous

**Rust quality**: OTel span per case (REQ-C4); per-subject debounce 15 min; queue-depth ceiling 500; LLM-said-no_action ≠ LLM-call-failed.

**Tests**: tests/llm_dispatcher_e2e.rs — FixtureClassifierClient + canned response; per-mode outcomes.

**Blocked by**: #232, #234
